question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the following question.

The given pie chart depicts the number of trousers purchased of four brands (P, Q, R and S). The total number of trousers purchased of the four brands together is 120.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e4965a372ea44e95e7f7f594df78e791daefa2f71d78e754603efc638cd6832.png] 

Out of the total number of trousers purchased of brands Q and R, one-third were slim fit trousers. What is the total number of slim fit trousers purchased of brands Q and R?
solution:
**Given:**

The given pie chart depicts the number of trousers purchased of four brands (P, Q, R, and S). The total number of trousers purchased of the four brands together is 120.

Out of the total number of trousers purchased of brands Q and R, one-third were slim fit trousers.

**Formula used:**

Total slim fit trousers of Q and R = (Total trousers of Q + Total trousers of R) × (1/3)

**Calculation:**

Let the number of trousers purchased of brand Q be Q and of brand R be R.

Total trousers purchased of brands Q and R = Q + R = 44 + 22 = 66

⇒ Total slim fit trousers of brands Q and R = 66 × (1/3)

⇒ Total slim fit trousers of brands Q and R = 22

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
